subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain an opt-in silent audio-history enrichment mode for `requireMention` channels, and what product/security boundary should gate stored transcripts?
rationale: The code change is bounded, but the requested behavior intentionally decouples STT from a visible bot invocation and adds public config, so automation should not choose the privacy/default/retention policy.

options.title: Keep open for maintainer design
options.body: Require a maintainer-approved shape for config scope, transcript retention/provenance, failure placeholders, provider boundaries, and docs before implementation.

options.title: Implement narrow opt-in
options.body: Allow a focused PR only if `preflightTranscribe` is default-off and proves allowed-sender checks, no assistant reply enqueue, transcript history retention, and failure handling.

options.title: Reject silent preflight
options.body: Keep current behavior where Discord audio preflight is only for active mention detection and normal accepted turns, avoiding hidden STT processing.

recommendation.title: Keep open for maintainer design
recommendation.body: Require a maintainer-approved shape for config scope, transcript retention/provenance, failure placeholders, provider boundaries, and docs before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the earlier Discord audio fix and central mention-policy history, making him the best available routing owner for the product/security tradeoff.
